notes: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED with ErrorInfo SERVICE_DISABLED, shaped as google/api/error_reason.proto's SERVICE_DISABLED example. Not recordable: needs a project with the API disabled. The error body is google.rpc.Status in its HTTP JSON mapping ({"error": {code, message, status, details}}); status names and their HTTP codes come from googleapis google/rpc/code.proto, details from google/rpc/error_details.proto and google/api/error_reason.proto (read 2026-10-28).
